description.raw:
This spell functions like protection from evil, except that the deflection and resistance bonuses apply to attacks made by good creatures. The target receives a new saving throw against control by good creatures and good summoned creatures cannot touch the target.Mythic Protection from GoodSource Mythic Adventures pg. 105
As mythic protection from evil, except against good creatures.
